# USB to Network Bridge

> Open-source USB over IP (USB/IP) redirector for Windows 11 x64, implemented in Rust. A server shares physical USB devices over LAN/VPN and Windows clients import selected devices through signed upstream USB drivers.

Project code is MIT-licensed. There is no project activation, trial timer or license-based device count. Native Rust and stock usbipd-win are selectable server backends sharing the same signed VBoxUSB capture driver. The Windows client uses signed USBIP-WIN2. Camera, Android phone/ADB and selected HID scenarios are documented; compatibility depends on hardware and drivers.
